tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your account: email, credit balance, free mailbox allowance (10, or 20 for accounts created before 27 October 2026, plus referral bonus), paid extras and your referral link.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: Every connected mailbox with warm-up day, status, 7-day spam rate, today's and last 7 days' numbers, and whether it is ready for outbound.

tools.name: get_mailbox
tools.description: One mailbox's warm-up status and health.

tools.name: mailbox_activity
tools.description: The last 100 warm-up events for a mailbox (sent, received, replied, rescued from spam, errors).

tools.name: warmup_stats
tools.description: Totals across your mailboxes: today and last 7 days (sent, received, rescued, replied), active and ready counts.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: IMAP/SMTP presets (Gmail app password, Yahoo, iCloud, Zoho, Lark, SES, SendGrid, Mailgun…) with hosts and ports, plus the Google and Zoho API routes.

tools.name: connect_imap_mailbox
tools.description: Connect any mailbox with IMAP + SMTP. The login is tested before it is saved. Use an app password when two-factor sign-in is on. Give a preset (see list_providers) or the hosts. Warm-up starts the same day.

tools.name: connect_zoho_mailbox
tools.description: Connect a Zoho Mail mailbox through the Zoho API (works on Zoho's free plan). Needs a Self Client id, secret and a generated code from api-console.zoho.com.

tools.name: google_connect_link
tools.description: Get a link the user opens to connect Gmail / Google Workspace with Google sign-in (one click, any device). The mailbox appears in list_mailboxes a few minutes after they allow it.

tools.name: update_mailbox
tools.description: Change a mailbox's display name, daily warm-up cap (1-100, null = default), time zone (IANA, e.g. Europe/London) or the signature added to its warm-up mail (empty = default: full name and company).

tools.name: pause_mailbox
tools.description: Pause warm-up for a mailbox.

tools.name: resume_mailbox
tools.description: Resume warm-up for a mailbox.

tools.name: test_mailbox
tools.description: Sign in to the mailbox now and report whether the stored login still works.

tools.name: remove_mailbox
tools.description: Remove a mailbox and delete its stored login. Irreversible: ask the user first, then pass confirm=true.

tools.name: set_pool_mode
tools.description: Shared network (default: warm with every mailbox on the service) or private pool (only your own mailboxes write to each other; needs 2+).

tools.name: set_warm_style
tools.description: Teach warm-up mail how you write: paste up to 4,000 characters of your own sent emails (tone, length, sign-offs). Empty clears it. Used when the AI writes your warm-up conversations.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: Client workspaces (agencies): each client's mailboxes are kept separate under one login and one bill. Returns id, name and mailbox count. Each mailbox in list_mailboxes has a workspace id (null = My mailboxes).

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create a client workspace, e.g. the client's company name (max 100 per account).

tools.name: rename_workspace
tools.description: Rename a client workspace.

tools.name: delete_workspace
tools.description: Delete a client workspace. Its mailboxes are NOT deleted: they move back to My mailboxes and keep warming. The client's report link stops working.

tools.name: move_mailbox_to_workspace
tools.description: Put a mailbox in a client workspace. Leave workspace_id out (or empty) to move it back to My mailboxes.

tools.name: get_workspace_report
tools.description: The public read-only report link for one client workspace (mailbox health, spam rate, SPF/DKIM/DMARC). The client opens it without a login; it shows no prices and nothing about other clients.

tools.name: domain_health
tools.description: SPF, DKIM selector, DMARC policy and MX for every domain you have connected.

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Look up a domain's SPF record.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Find a domain's DKIM key: tries the selector you give, selectors seen in real mail, then 45 common ones.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Look up a domain's DMARC record and policy.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Prepaid credit balance, prices and recent charges (Outbound emails, AI drafts).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Your Outbound campaigns with status and stats.

tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign: its emails, mailboxes, stats and time left.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: Create a draft Outbound campaign (nothing is sent). Emails can use {first_name}, {company} and any contact field. Any connected mailbox can send; one that is still warming shows a warning first.

tools.name: update_campaign
tools.description: Edit a paused or draft campaign. Fields you leave out keep their value.

tools.name: add_contacts
tools.description: Add up to 1,000 contacts to a campaign. Each needs email; other fields (first_name, company…) fill the placeholders. Duplicates and unsubscribed addresses are skipped.

tools.name: list_campaign_contacts
tools.description: Contacts in a campaign and where each is in the sequence (first 200).

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start or resume a campaign. This SENDS real email and uses credits. Confirm with the user first. accept_sending_rules=true means the user agrees to https://emailwarmup.bobwork.ai/terms#outbound-beta (only people who may receive it, honest sender, unsubscribe honoured). If a chosen mailbox is still w

tools.name: pause_campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign.

tools.name: get_billing_status
tools.description: Payment status after you gave the user a checkout link: credit balance, whether the extra-mailbox subscription is active, mailboxes vs the free limit, and checkouts still waiting for payment. Confirms a paid checkout straight away.

tools.name: create_billing_checkout
tools.description: Get a Stripe Checkout url for extra mailboxes beyond the free limit (monthly, or yearly = 10 months' price for 12). The USER opens it and pays; you cannot. Then poll get_billing_status. Returns already:true when the account is subscribed. Prices come back in the result (prices).

tools.name: create_credits_checkout
tools.description: Get a Stripe Checkout url to top up prepaid credits for Outbound sending and AI drafts (one-off $5, $10, $25 or $100; credits never expire). The USER opens it and pays; you cannot. Then poll get_billing_status.

tools.name: list_bought_domains
tools.description: Domains bought in the domain shop, their hosted mailboxes, renewal date and price, plus IMAP/SMTP settings.

tools.name: search_domains
tools.description: Find available lookalike domains for cold email, with first-term and renewal prices.

tools.name: buy_domains
tools.description: Buy domains with up to 3 mailboxes each. Returns a Stripe checkout link for the person to pay; setup starts once paid. Needs accept_sending_rules true.

tools.name: add_hosted_mailboxes
tools.description: Add mailboxes to a domain you bought here ($3 per mailbox per month). Returns a Stripe checkout link.

tools.name: hosted_mailbox_login
tools.description: Password, IMAP and SMTP settings for one of your hosted mailboxes.

tools.name: list_dns_records
tools.description: DNS records on a domain you bought here.

tools.name: add_dns_record
tools.description: Add a DNS record to a domain you bought here. name = subdomain ('' for the domain itself). Types A, AAAA, CNAME, ALIAS, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV.

tools.name: delete_dns_record
tools.description: Delete a DNS record by id (from list_dns_records). Deleting MX, SPF, DKIM or DMARC stops the mailboxes working.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, get_credits, get_campaign, start_campaign, create_billing_checkout, create_credits_checkout, search_domains · Private data: list_providers, connect_imap_mailbox, connect_zoho_mailbox, set_pool_mode, check_spf, check_dmarc, create_campaign, add_contacts, list_campaign_contacts, hosted_mailbox_login, list_dns_records, add_dns_record, delete_dns_record · Public sink: get_account, create_campaign, add_contacts, start_campaign, search_domains · Destructive: remove_mailbox, delete_workspace, delete_dns_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, get_credits, get_campaign, start_campaign, create_billing_checkout, create_credits_checkout, search_domains · Private data: list_providers, connect_imap_mailbox, connect_zoho_mailbox, set_pool_mode, check_spf, check_dmarc, create_campaign, add_contacts, list_campaign_contacts, hosted_mailbox_login, list_dns_records, add_dns_record, delete_dns_record · Public sink: get_account, create_campaign, add_contacts, start_campaign, search_domains · Destructive: remove_mailbox, delete_workspace, delete_dns_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
